result.title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
result.summary: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. Yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. We address this with Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. In LSA, keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space, and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key, making prefill, decode and training faster at long context. We propose two variants, Distilled-LSA (D-LSA), which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation, and Native-LSA (N-LSA), which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. On GLM-5.3-FLASH (QWEN-3.8-27B) at 10M tokens, D-LSA speeds up one attention layer by 22.7x (72.4x) in prefill and 4.6x (42.5x) in decode over its original sparse attention (full attention), while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. N-LSA matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6x per layer at 128k tokens. LSA offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Latent Sparse Attention（LSA）：在学到的 latent 空间中对 key 做层次聚类，让 query 只对簇层级打分而非逐 key 打分，从而在超长上下文下降低 prefill、decode 与训练成本，并给出蒸馏版 D-LSA 与原生训练版 N-LSA 的加速与精度结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent 空间层次索引 + 稀疏证据选择」这一注意力结构线索，可能与 LVR 中长视觉/上下文证据筛选及注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响有关，可供核查；但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成或 latent reasoning。
